name: Polymarket

website.description: Real-time prediction market data from Polymarket: browse events, check market prices, and search across politics, sports, crypto, and current events. Public API, no key needed.
useCases: Check prediction market odds on current events
Research market sentiment on a topic
Pin a market and watch its probability move

contextMessage: Polymarket prediction markets are available (no key needed). Use polymarket_get_markets, polymarket_search, polymarket_get_event, and polymarket_price_history to query odds, volume, and price history.

assetTypes.name: Event
assetTypes.description: A prediction market event: a group of related markets, like an election with one market per candidate

assetTypes.name: Market
assetTypes.description: One prediction market: a question with outcome prices that move as people trade

tools.name: polymarket_get_markets
tools.description: Get a list of prediction markets from Polymarket. Returns markets with their questions, outcome prices, volume, and trading status.

limit.description: Maximum number of markets to return (default 25, max 100)

offset.description: Number of markets to skip for pagination (default 0)

active.description: Filter for active markets only (default true)

tools.name: polymarket_get_market
tools.description: Get detailed information about one prediction market by its ID or slug: description, outcome prices, volume, liquidity, dates, and resolution source.

market_id.description: The market ID or slug to fetch

tools.name: polymarket_get_events
tools.description: Get a list of events from Polymarket. Events are groups of related markets, like an election with one market per candidate.

limit.description: Maximum number of events to return (default 25, max 100)

offset.description: Number of events to skip for pagination (default 0)

active.description: Filter for active events only (default true)

tools.name: polymarket_get_event
tools.description: Get detailed information about one event by its ID or slug, including all its markets with their current outcome prices.

event_id.description: The event ID or slug to fetch

tools.name: polymarket_search
tools.description: Search prediction market events by keyword. Matches titles, descriptions, and slugs.

query.description: Search query to match against event titles and descriptions

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default 25)

active.description: Filter for active events only (default true)

tools.name: polymarket_price_history
tools.description: Get historical price/probability data for a prediction market. Returns timestamped price points per outcome showing how the odds moved.

market_id.description: The market ID or slug to fetch price history for

fidelity.description: Resolution in minutes; lower means more data points (default 60)

tools.name: polymarket_browse
tools.description: Browse events and markets for the asset picker (internal — not an LLM tool).

search.description: Search query from the browse UI

parentId.description: Event id when browsing a specific event's markets
